## LoggedDecoratorOptions.doNotThrow property

Set to `true` to swallow the error after logging it, in which case the method resolves to `undefined`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
doNotThrow?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Inverted sense: by default the error is re-thrown.
